mechanism: Darunavir inhibits CYP3A4, increasing prochlorperazine metabolism inhibition and elevating antipsychotic levels; both drugs have QT-prolongation potential and CNS depressant effects.
action: Monitor for extrapyramidal symptoms, QTc prolongation, and increased prochlorperazine toxicity; consider ECG monitoring and dose adjustment of prochlorperazine if needed.
